== Notes ==
* Heroes will maintain this skill in combat even when fighting enemies that don't apply any conditions. This is useful for triggering skills that trigger when an enchantment ends, such as [[form]]s. 
* When used in conjunction with an attack skill that removes an enchantment, conditions are cured before the hit lands.
* If the condition removal effect is unwanted (to keep Conviction's regeneration and armor increase effects), it can be worth considering using an [[enchanting]] upgrade component (or an effect reducing recharge time) to maintain this skill on yourself, as conditions are not removed if the enchantment is reapplied before it ends.
